entities.name: PMID:27510704
observations: In swine cardiac ischemia–reperfusion, carperitide (synthetic ANP; n=8) versus untreated control (n=8) was followed by 30-minute LAD occlusion and 4-hour reperfusion.
In ischemic myocardium, PPARγ mRNA and protein were significantly higher after carperitide; differences were not significant in marginal or non-ischemic areas.

entities.name: ANP–PPARγ in swine I/R
observations: Controlled carperitide treatment was associated with significantly increased PPARγ mRNA and protein in ischemic pig myocardium after ischemia–reperfusion; this establishes increased expression, not direct activation or mediation of cardioprotection.
